description: Java class representing a session (Sessao) for an event or show, including properties such as start time, duration, tickets, and reservation logic.

classes.name: Sessao
classes.description: Model class for event sessions, handling ticket bookings and scheduling details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the session.

methods.name: setEspetaculo
methods.description: Associates an Espetaculo (show) with this session.

methods.name: getInicio
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of the session.

methods.name: setInicio
methods.description: Sets the start time of the session.

methods.name: getEspetaculo
methods.description: Returns the associated show for the session.

methods.name: getDuracaoEmMinutos
methods.description: Returns the duration of the session in minutes.

methods.name: setDuracaoEmMinutos
methods.description: Sets the duration of the session in minutes.

methods.name: getDia
methods.description: Returns the date of the session formatted in short date pattern for pt-BR locale.

methods.name: getHora
methods.description: Returns the time of day of the session formatted in short time pattern for pt-BR locale.

methods.name: getTotalIngressos
methods.description: Returns the total number of tickets available.

methods.name: setTotalIngressos
methods.description: Sets the total number of tickets available.

methods.name: getIngressosReservados
methods.description: Returns the number of tickets reserved.

methods.name: setIngressosReservados
methods.description: Sets the number of reserved tickets.

methods.name: getIngressosDisponiveis
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of available tickets.

methods.name: reserva
methods.description: Reserves a specified number of tickets.

methods.name: podeReservar
methods.description: Checks if a specified number of tickets can be reserved.
